about: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B GPTQ Int4 with its MTP head (4 draft tokens) on two Intel Arc Pro B70 (tensor parallel 2): Intel's llm-scaler vLLM 0.26.1 for XPU, XPU graphs on, fp8 KV, vision on, 262K context
args: mkdir -p /dev/dri/by-path && for r in /dev/dri/renderD*; do ln -sf "../${r##*/}" "/dev/dri/by-path/pci-$(basename "$(readlink -f "/sys/class/drm/${r##*/}/device")")-render"; done; source /opt/intel/oneapi/setvars.sh --force && source /opt/intel/oneapi/ccl/2021.15/env/vars.sh --force && exec vllm serve "$@"
setup: NOT ACCEPTED: written so the two-card variant is plugin-eligible once a lab run passes; never run (the second B70 on omarchy, 0000:c3:00.0, is parked after a PCIe incident). Ship it only if a lab run beats the one-card recipe (qwen3.6-35b-a3b.vllm.256k on intel-arc-pro-b70-32gb: decode 98.9 tok/s, prefill 1609 tok/s). Same image, weights and entrypoint as the one-card launch: both passed render nodes are linked under /dev/dri/by-path for oneCCL, whose pidfd handle exchange falls back to drmfd without extra capabilities (seen in the one-card run), so no --ipc host, SYS_PTRACE or seccomp flags are used; shm 16g covers the shared memory --ipc host provided in the older SGLang TP=2 launch. TP=3 is not offered: 16 attention heads do not split three ways.
